decisions.reason: As a close-to-core support add-on that reinforces the firm's service positioning and likely has manageable carrying costs, it remains a worthwhile option unless demand is clearly weak.

Because this version management tool builds on the firm's hosting platform and automation capabilities, its strategic fit and complementarity make continued retention more attractive than abandonment.

This compliance-contract tool is relatively distant from the firm's core hosting business, and after several years its uncertainty is likely resolved enough that scarce development attention is better redeployed to stronger, more related options.
As a flagship, agency-focused hosting line directly aligned with the firm's stated direction and core resources, it is the kind of option management would continue backing rather than withdraw.
